name: Oxymorphol
summary: Oxymorphol is oxymorphone which has been hydrogenated at the 6-position and consists of a mixture of 4,5α-epoxy-17-methylmorphinan-3,6β,14-triol and 4,5α-epoxy-17-methylmorphinan-3,6α,14-triol (hydromorphinol). It is produced by the human body as an active metabolite of oxymorphone and some bacteria as an intermediate in turning morphine into hydromorphone.

pharmacology.text: It is produced by the human body as an active metabolite of oxymorphone and some bacteria as an intermediate in turning morphine into hydromorphone.

uses.en: It has no medical use. It is of interest as a breakdown product of oxymorphone and in drug testing.
uses.zh: 它沒有醫療用途，之所以受到關注，是因為它是羥嗎啡酮的分解產物，也與藥物檢驗有關。
uses.zhHans: 它没有医疗用途，之所以受到关注，是因为它是羟吗啡酮的分解产物，也与药物检验有关。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its class, the opioids, cause drowsiness, nausea, constipation and slowed breathing, and an overdose can stop breathing altogether.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。它所屬的鴉片類藥物會造成嗜睡、噁心、便祕與呼吸變慢，過量時可能導致呼吸完全停止。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。它所属的鸦片类药物会造成嗜睡、恶心、便秘与呼吸变慢，过量时可能导致呼吸完全停止。

fact.en: Gut bacteria can make it from oxymorphone, and so can the human body, which is one reason drug test results can be hard to interpret.
fact.zh: 腸道細菌能把羥嗎啡酮轉變成它，人體本身也會，這也是藥物檢驗結果有時難以解讀的原因之一。
fact.zhHans: 肠道细菌能把羟吗啡酮转变成它，人体本身也会，这也是药物检验结果有时难以解读的原因之一。
